products.name: Osung prosthesis and abutment separator implant crown separator -PAS10

variants.label: Osung prosthesis and abutment separator implant crown separator -PAS10

products.description: The Osung Prosthesis & Abutment Separator is a professional implant prosthesis retrieval instrument designed to provide controlled, predictable, and damage-free separation of implant crowns and abutments. This advanced dental prosthetic separator helps clinicians safely remove implant restorations while preserving valuable prosthetic components. Ideal for implant prosthodontic procedures, this implant restoration removal tool eliminates unnecessary force and reduces the risk of damaging porcelain, ceramic, or implant components during crown and abutment separation. Watch the video: Your browser does not support our video. Key Components & Dimensions The Osung Prosthesis & Abutment Separator features a modular system engineered to accommodate multiple dental implant sizes for accurate and secure prosthesis removal. 8mm Insert Outer Diameter: Ø8mm Total Height: 11mm Lip Height: 4mm 6mm Insert Outer Diameter: Ø6mm Internal Height: 8mm Lower Stem Height: 6mm This versatile dental abutment separator system allows clinicians to manage various implant restoration configurations efficiently. How the Prosthesis & Abutment Separator Works The separator operates using a precision mechanical screw-press system that delivers controlled vertical force for safe implant prosthesis retrieval. 1. Selection The clinician selects the appropriate insert (6mm,8mm) and places it into the base of the separator frame to match the implant abutment size. the separator can be used without an insert for the diameter of 10mm. 2. Alignment The crown-abutment assembly is carefully seated into the insert for optimal stabilization. 3. Separation As the ergonomic T-handle is rotated, a precision-guided plunger descends through the center of the implant crown. 4. Controlled Removal The plunger applies steady vertical pressure directly to the abutment screw or post while the frame securely stabilizes the crown. This process cleanly separates the abutment from the internal housing of the prosthesis without excessive force. Clinical Benefits Preservation of Prosthetic Components Unlike traditional manual techniques, this dental implant crown removal tool eliminates prying or uncontrolled force that may fracture porcelain or ceramic restorations. Improved Efficiency The prosthesis separator simplifies difficult implant restoration removal procedures, especially when friction-fit crowns and abutments are tightly connected. Precision & Safety The guided plunger mechanism ensures force is applied precisely along the long axis of the implant restoration, minimizing lateral stress and protecting both the prosthesis and implant components. Reliable Implant Prosthesis Retrieval Designed for modern implant dentistry, the Osung Prosthesis & Abutment Separator provides clinicians with a dependable solution for implant crown separation, prosthetic component retrieval, and restorative implant maintenance. Whether performing routine implant maintenance or managing complex restorative cases, this professional dental implant separator helps save clinical time while protecting costly implant prosthetic components.

products.name: Endo Z Bur, Conical End, Dome End Side Cutting Only 1 mm Dia. Medium Grit Diamond Bur 5 per pack. 215.10M1

variants.label: Endo Z Bur, Conical End, Dome End Side Cutting Only 1 mm Dia. Medium Grit Diamond Bur 5 per pack. 215.10M1

products.categoryPath: Diamond Burs > Conical End Dome End Side Cutting Only > Dental Burs > Diamond Burs
products.description: 215.10M1, CONICAL END, DOME END SIDE CUTTING ONLY, 1 MM DIA, MEDIUM GRIT DIAMOND BUR, 5 PER PACK ISO Number: 215 Shape: Conical End, Dome End Side Cutting Only Roughness: Medium Grit Size: 105-125 µm Head Dia (mm): 1 Pieces per pack: 5 Product Code: 215.10M1 ALT Code (if any): None SKU: 28-215.10M1 Our Endo Z bur is a specialized bur used primarily during the early stages of a root canal procedure (endodontics). Its standout feature is its non-cutting "safe-end" tip. Key Characteristics - Non-Cutting Tip: The very end of the bur is smooth and rounded. It does not cut vertically. - Lateral Cutting Blades: The sides of the bur have spiral flutes (usually 6 blades) made of tungsten carbide that cut very efficiently. - Tapered Shape: The bur is long and slightly conical, allowing it to create a "funnel" shape as it moves. What is it used for? The OSUNG Endo Z bur is designed for access cavity refinement. Once a dentist has used a standard round bur to "drop into" the pulp chamber of a tooth, they switch to the Endo Z bur to: Remove the Pulp Roof: It safely cuts away the ceiling of the pulp chamber to expose the root canal openings. Flatten Internal Walls: Its lateral blades smooth and straighten the internal walls of the tooth. Prevent Perforation: Because the tip doesn't cut, the dentist can rest it on the "floor" of the pulp chamber without worrying about accidentally drilling through the bottom of the tooth (perforation). Create Funnel Access: It shapes the opening into a funnel, making it much easier to insert delicate root canal files into the tiny canal orifices.
